svg.title: The Iron Curtain, Truman Doctrine, Marshall Plan and Soviet Satellite States (1946–49)
svg.desc: Conic-projection GIS historical atlas map of Europe showing Western European Marshall Plan recipients (1948), Greece and Turkey under the March 1947 Truman Doctrine, Soviet Cominform and Comecon satellite states, Tito's Yugoslavia expelled from Cominform in June 1948, the USSR, and the Stettin-to-Trieste Iron Curtain.
